narration: Desert villages made ice on nights the air stayed above freezing. No machines. No refrigerant.
caption: रेगिस्तानी गाँव उन रातों बर्फ़ बनाते थे जब हवा शून्य से ऊपर रहती थी।
image_brief: A long open trench in a desert village at night, lined with rows of shallow clay pans resting on straw, thin skins of ice on the water, a high mud wall along one side, faint starlight overhead.

narration: Shallow clay pans. A bed of straw. A wall for shade. That was the whole machine.
caption: उथले मिट्टी के तवे, पुआल का बिस्तर, छाया के लिए दीवार। बस इतनी ही मशीन।
image_brief: Close view of one unglazed clay pan set into loose straw, water barely a finger deep inside it, a fragile ice sheet across the middle, straw stalks catching the last blue light.

narration: The same thing happens on your car every clear winter morning. Frost on the roof.
caption: हर साफ़ सर्दी की सुबह आपकी कार पर वही होता है। छत पर पाला।
image_brief: A parked hatchback seen from slightly above at dawn, its metal roof completely white with frost while the door panels stay clear, pale orange sky behind the rooftops.

narration: The road beside it stays completely bare. Same air, same night, same hour. Why the difference?
caption: पास की सड़क ख़ाली रहती है। वही हवा, वही रात, वही घड़ी। फिर अंतर क्यों?
image_brief: Low ground-level view along a dark asphalt street at first light, the tarmac wet-dark and bare, a frosted white kerbstone and frosted grass verge running beside it.

narration: Your thermometer is not broken. It reads four degrees while ice forms two metres away.
caption: आपका थर्मामीटर ख़राब नहीं है। वह चार डिग्री दिखाता है, दो मीटर दूर बर्फ़ बनती है।
image_brief: A round dial thermometer screwed to a garden wall with its needle sitting above zero, and directly below it a low hedge whose leaves are rimmed with white frost.

narration: Something above is pulling heat out of every surface that faces the sky. All night.
caption: ऊपर कुछ है जो आसमान की तरफ़ खुली हर सतह से गर्मी खींचता है। पूरी रात।
image_brief: A wide flat field at night under a clear star-filled sky, the ground pale with frost from edge to edge, a single bare tree standing far off on the horizon line.

narration: Frost is only the visible version. The invisible one runs every clear night, everywhere.
caption: पाला सिर्फ़ दिखने वाला हिस्सा है। न दिखने वाला हिस्सा हर साफ़ रात चलता है।
image_brief: A corrugated tin shed roof photographed from ground level at first light, an even coat of white frost across the ridges, the walls below still dry and dark.

narration: Dew on morning grass is the same effect, one step warmer. Nothing rained.
caption: सुबह घास पर ओस वही असर है, एक कदम गर्म। बारिश नहीं हुई थी।
image_brief: Extreme close view of a single blade of grass bent under a line of clear water beads, blurred green field behind it, soft grey pre-sunrise light.

narration: It decides whether a mango crop in flower survives a cold night. Growers watch it.
caption: यह तय करता है कि फूल आए आम की फ़सल ठंडी रात बचेगी या नहीं।
image_brief: Clusters of pale mango blossom on a low branch at dawn, a thin white bloom of frost on the outer flower tips, an orchard of hazy trees receding behind.

narration: It is why a clear desert night falls twenty degrees below the same afternoon.
caption: इसी वजह से साफ़ रेगिस्तानी रात दोपहर से बीस डिग्री ठंडी हो जाती है।
image_brief: A rocky desert basin at night, bare stone and gravel stretching to distant ridges, everything lit cold blue by starlight, no cloud anywhere in the sky.

narration: It is why a parked bike seat frosts and the concrete underneath does not. Two feet apart.
caption: इसी से खड़ी साइकिल की सीट पर पाला जमता है और नीचे का फ़र्श सूखा रहता है।
image_brief: A bicycle standing on a concrete driveway at sunrise, its saddle and handlebars furred with white frost, the concrete slab beneath plain grey and dry.

narration: Weather stations know this. Their thermometers sit inside a white shaded box on purpose.
caption: मौसम केंद्र यह जानते हैं। उनके थर्मामीटर जान-बूझकर सफ़ेद छायादार बक्से में रखे जाते हैं।
image_brief: A white louvred wooden weather screen on a short post in a mown grass enclosure, its slatted sides angled downward, flat overcast daylight around it.

narration: That box shields the sensor from the open sky. It measures air, not radiation.
caption: वह बक्सा सेंसर को खुले आसमान से बचाता है। वह हवा नापता है, विकिरण नहीं।
image_brief: Detail of the open door of a louvred weather screen with a slim glass thermometer mounted vertically in the shaded interior, angled slats visible on both sides.

narration: So the number you read describes the air. The grass is colder. Sometimes much colder.
caption: तो जो नंबर आप पढ़ते हैं वह हवा का है। घास उससे ठंडी होती है।
image_brief: A suburban lawn at sunrise covered evenly in white frost, one dark trail of footprints pressed through it, long shadows from a fence running across the grass.

narration: Ground frost warnings exist because of that gap. Air above zero, grass below it.
caption: ज़मीनी पाले की चेतावनी इसी अंतर से आती है। हवा शून्य से ऊपर, घास नीचे।
image_brief: Ground-level view down a furrow between two rows of low winter crop, frost outlining every leaf edge, a clear colourless sky filling the top of the frame.
